mapping.author: claude-mapper-m6
mapping.draft_py:
# Skyknight Squire (FDN), a 1/1 Cat Scout for {1}{W}.
# "Whenever another creature you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
#  As long as this creature has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, it has flying and is a Knight
#  in addition to its other types."
# [0] Event: M21 Terror of the Peaks' verified "Whenever another creature you control enters"
#     (ZoneChangeEvent to your battlefield, subject your creature and FNot IS_SOURCE); once per
#     creature (no once_per_event). Effect: M21 Lorescale Coatl's verified "put a +1/+1 counter
#     on this creature".
# [1] "As long as" is the StaticAbility's condition (D22, M11 Serra Ascendant / FDN Twinblade
#     Paladin, B14-as-long-as-self), read over the source: HAS_COUNTER +1/+1 with count 3 is
#     "three or more" (quantity.py: counters >= count; M21 Sigiled Contender's verified gate is the
#     count-1 form). The grants are Serra Ascendant's self selectors; "is a Knight in addition to
#     its other types" is M21 Dub's verified GRANT_TYPE ('Knight',), in printed order after the
#     flying grant (Dub's order).
other_enters = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAnd(
            children=(
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
            ),
        ),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.PUT_COUNTER, {
        'count': QConst(value=1),
        'counter_kind': CounterKind.PLUS_1_PLUS_1,
        'target': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
            filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        ),
    }),
)
self_sel = Selector(
    count=QConst(value=1),
    mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
    filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
)
knight = StaticAbility(
    effect=Seq(
        steps=(
            A(Verb.GRANT_ABILITY, {
                'ability': KeywordAbility(keyword=Keyword.FLYING),
                'target': self_sel,
            }),
            A(Verb.GRANT_TYPE, {
                'target': self_sel,
                'types': ('Knight',),
            }),
        ),
    ),
    condition=FAtom(
        pred=FAtomPred.HAS_COUNTER,
        count=QConst(value=3),
        counter_kind=CounterKind.PLUS_1_PLUS_1,
    ),
)
abilities = [other_enters, knight, *compiled]

clauses.clause: Whenever another creature you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
As long as this creature has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, it has flying and is a Knight in addition to its other types.

mapping.notes: M21 Terror of the Peaks' 'another creature you control enters' with Lorescale Coatl's counter on the source; 'as long as' as StaticAbility.condition HAS_COUNTER 3 (D22, FDN Kitesail Corsair's form), M21 Dub's GRANT_TYPE Knight. No pack sees the Knight type (no lane reads types; no FDN card reads Knights). Packs: tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/skyknight_squire_two_goblins_two_counters.json, tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/skyknight_squire_three_counters_fly.json, tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/skyknight_squire_two_counters_no_flying.json.
